subject: Shopify redesign for our candle shop
body:
Hi there,

We run Loom & Leaf, a small candle brand doing about 400 orders a month on Shopify. Our theme is five years old and mobile checkout is clunky. We'd like a redesign with a better product page and bundles.

Budget is around $5,000 to $7,000 and we'd love to launch before Black Friday, so ideally within 8 weeks.

Could we set up a call?

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Customer portal for a logistics company
body:
Hello Kestrel team,

I'm the operations director at Fleetwise, a 40-person courier company. Our customers track deliveries by phoning us, which takes up most of our support time. We want a web portal where business customers can log in, see live delivery status from our dispatch system (it has a REST API) and download proof-of-delivery PDFs.

We have budget approved for this quarter. Timeline is flexible but we'd like something live in Q1.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor
